blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World-action models aim to turn visual anticipation into driving decisions, yet typically train action experts on trajectory representations defined independently of visual dynamics. This motivates deriving action targets directly from visual motion. We first examine a simpler setting in which trajectories are reconstructed from recorded future images. Even without the need for future prediction, reconstruction captures the dominant maneuver but leaves centimeter-scale errors. We therefore introduce VITAL (Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning), an action tokenizer that couples a visually derived motion scaffold with a compact residual encoding the trajectory error left by that scaffold. This representation makes visual motion the principal prediction target and gives small metric corrections a separate, normalized learning scale. Using flow matching, the action expert jointly predicts both components from the current image, ego state, and navigation command, without generating future images at inference. The same residual coordinates support bounded reinforcement post-training that refines execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed. With only one action denoising step, VITAL achieves 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, within 0.13 points of its ten-step score at 3.29x the end-to-end inference speed. Without retraining, it achieves 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and 38.6 on navhard. Project page: https://worldbench.github.io/vital
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式旨在将视觉预测转化为驱动决策,但通常对行动专家进行独立于视觉动态的轨道表现方面的培训。 这促使人们直接从视觉运动中得出行动目标。 我们首先检查一个更简单的设置,从记录的未来图像中重建轨迹。 即使不需要未来的预测,重建也抓住了主导策略,但留下了厘米尺度的错误。 因此,我们引入了VITAL(Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning),这是一种动作标语器,将一个视觉衍生运动脚手架与该脚手架留下的轨迹错误进行紧凑的剩余编码结合在一起。 这种表述方式使视觉运动成为主要预测目标,并给小的度量校正一个单独的正常学习尺度. 利用流匹配,动作专家联合从当前图像,自负状态,和导航指令中预测两个组件,而不在推论中生成未来的图像. 同样的剩余坐标支持 捆绑的强化 后训练 精炼执行 同时保持 预测的视觉脚手架固定。 仅用一个动作解诺步骤,VITAL在NAVSIM v1导航测试上实现了90.8 PDMS,在它的十步分数的0.13分范围内,以3.29x的终到推断速度. 不进行再培训,它在NAVSIM v2导航测试上实现了91.1 EPDMS,在Navhard上实现了38.6. 项目网页:https://worldbench.github.io/vital

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Learning to anticipate a driving scene should also help a vehicle decide how to move. World-action models pursue this connection by coupling visual prediction with trajectory generation ( xia2026drivelaw ; zhao2026simwam ; yuan2026suv ) . A common design couples video and action experts in a mixture of transformers, allowing action tokens to attend to visual features before decoding an ego trajectory ( zhao2026simwam ; li2026metis ; yuan2026suv ) . As illustrated in Fig. \texorpdfstring \pdfxform @: From Visual Motion to Precise Action VITAL: From Visual Motion to Precise Action , the promise is to learn how to act from a model that anticipates how the world moves.
blocks.zh: 学会预想出一个行驶场景也有助于车辆决定如何行走. 世界行动模型通过将视觉预测与轨迹生成(xia2026drivelaw;zhao2026simwam;人民币2026suv)相接来实现这种连接. 由变压器混合而成的普通设计配对视频和动作专家,允许动作符在解码自负轨迹之前关注视觉特征(zhao2026simwam; li2026metis; 人民币2026suv). 如图.\texorpdfstring\pdfxform @: 从视觉动作到精准动作VITAL:从视觉动作到精准动作,承诺是学习如何从一个预想世界如何移动的模型中行动.

blocks.en: Yet exchanging information does not necessarily give the two experts a shared prediction target. Attention ( vaswani2017attention ) connects their features, while the video expert learns to predict scene evolution and the action expert often learns a code defined only by trajectory coordinates. The two experts describe the same physical motion through separately constructed representations. We therefore ask whether action targets can be derived directly from observed visual motion.
blocks.zh: 然而,交流信息并不一定给两位专家一个共同的预测目标。 注意 (vaswani 2017atent) 连接了他们的特性,而视频专家学习预测场景演化,而动作专家常常学习一个仅由轨迹坐标定义的代码. 两位专家通过单独构建的表述来描述同样的物理运动. 因此,我们询问行动目标是否可以直接从可观察到的视觉运动中得出。

blocks.en: Recent advances in robot control suggest that this connection can be learned at the tokenizer level. RepWAM ( wang2026repwam ) learns latent actions from transitions between semantically aligned visual representations, and LingBot-VA 2.0 ( zhang2026native ) adopts this strategy for joint pretraining of video and action. Their gains in control precision make visual motion a promising source of action targets. Motion-token and continuous-motion learning offer complementary evidence for connecting videos to control ( chen2025moto ; yang2026como ) . However, these tokenizers reconstruct transitions in visual feature space. It remains unclear how much of the metric detail needed for driving can be recovered from visual motion alone, even before a planner has to predict that motion from the observations available at deployment.
blocks.zh: 最近在机器人控制方面的进步表明,这种连接可以在示意器级别上被了解. RepWAM(wang2026repwam)从精准对齐的视觉表现和LingBot-VA 2.0(zhang2026native)之间的过渡中学习出潜在的动作,采用这一策略对视频和行动进行联合预训. 它们在控制精度方面的收益使得视觉运动成为有希望的行动目标来源. 动能和连续动能学习为将视频连接到控制(chen2025moto;yang2026como)提供了补充证据. 然而,这些标致器在视觉特征空间重建了过渡. 仍然不清楚的是,即使在规划人员不得不从部署时的观测结果中预测出这一运动之前,仅凭视觉运动就可以恢复驾驶所需的多少基本细节。

blocks.en: We therefore remove future prediction from the problem altogether. As shown in Appendix , in a simpler task than world-action modeling, the model receives recorded current and future images and reconstructs the corresponding ego trajectory. Even with the future already in view, a precision gap remains. As shown in Fig. 2 , reconstruction leaves 123.6 mm average displacement error (ADE) and 221.6 mm final displacement error (FDE) across all NAVSIM validation scenes ( dauner2024navsim ) . Looking more closely at the recovered motion, we find that its HF fraction, the mean share of velocity energy at high frequencies across x x and y y , is only 0.1%. What emerges is a smooth motion scaffold. It captures the maneuver but still misses metric detail that matters near road boundaries, where small deviations can make an otherwise plausible trajectory noncompliant.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们完全取消了未来的预测。 如附录所示,在比世界行动模型更简单的任务中,该模型接收录入的当前和未来图像并重建相应的自负轨迹. 即使已经展望未来,仍然存在着精确的差距。 如图2所示,重建在所有NAVSIM验证场景(dauner2024navsim)中留下123.6毫米平均迁移错误(ADE)和221.6毫米最终迁移错误(FDE). 更仔细地观察回收的运动, 我们发现它的高频分数, 高频率速度能量的平均比例 跨越x和y, 仅为0.1%。 出现的是平滑运动脚手架. 它掌握了各种策略,但仍然忽略了接近道路边界的大致细节,因为小的偏差可能使本来可行的轨迹不符合要求。

blocks.en: This finding suggests preserving the motion that vision captures while giving the missing detail a representation of its own. We introduce \texorpdfstring \pdfxform @ VITAL, short for Vision-Induced Tokens for Action Learning, an action tokenizer built around this separation. A visual motion code decodes into the trajectory scaffold. A second code, the paired metric residual, encodes the difference between that scaffold and the demonstrated trajectory. Normalization gives these small corrections their own learning scale alongside the dominant motion. Decoding both codes restores the missing trajectory detail. As shown in Fig. 2 , supplying recorded images and the residual encoded from ground truth reduces reconstruction ADE and FDE to 0.3 mm and 0.5 mm and raises PDMS from 92.1 to 94.7. The residual’s HF fraction reaches 61.4%, revealing faster local variations in the component that restores metric precision. The resulting representation retains both the visual motion scaffold and the finer corrections needed to reconstruct the demonstrated trajectory.
blocks.zh: 这一结论表明,应保留视觉所抓住的动向,同时让缺失的细节反映其自身。 我们介绍\texorpdfstring\pdfxform @VITAL,简称为视觉-诱导的Tokens for Action Learning,是围绕这次分离而构建的动作示意器. 视觉运动代码解码入轨迹脚手架. 第二个代码,对称的公尺残基, 编码了脚手架和显示的轨迹之间的区别。 规范化使这些小的校正与主运动相伴而来的是它们自己的学习尺度. 解码两种代码恢复了缺失的轨迹细节. 如图2所示,提供记录的图像和从地面真相编码的残余物使重建ADE和FDE减少为0.3毫米和0.5毫米,并将PDMS从92.1提高到94.7。 剩余高频分数达到61.4%,揭示出恢复公制精度的组件的局部变化更快. 由此产生的表述既保留了视觉运动脚手架,也保留了重建所显示轨迹所需的更细微的校正.

blocks.en: Precise reconstruction is useful for planning only if the representation can be predicted before the future is observed, consistent with recent analyses of action tokenization beyond reconstruction fidelity ( chen2026proact ) . We train the action expert with flow matching to generate both codes jointly from the current image, ego state, and navigation command. One flow step then produces a trajectory without generating future images. Separating the metric correction also opens a route to policy improvement ( johannink2019residual ) . After imitation learning, we freeze the action generator and decoder and learn bounded updates in the residual coordinates. At deployment, a single deterministic correction refines local execution while keeping the predicted visual scaffold fixed.
blocks.zh: 只有在观察未来之前能够预测其代表性,符合最近对重建忠心以外的行动表示性的分析(chen2026proact ),精确的重建才对规划有用。 我们训练动作专家进行流相匹配,从当前图像,自负状态和导航指令共同生成两个代码. 然后一个流程步骤产生一个轨迹,而不产生未来的图像。 分离度量校正也为改进政策开辟了道路(johannink2019 remainual ). 在模仿学习后,我们冻结了动作生成器和解码器,并学习了剩余坐标中的有界更新. 在部署时,一个单一的定型校正完善了局部行刑,同时使预测的视觉脚手架固定.

blocks.en: The gains extend from reconstruction to planning. On NAVSIM, \texorpdfstring \pdfxform @ VITAL strengthens visual conditioning. With equal action training budgets, it gains 5.1 PDMS points in one step over an autoencoder trained only on trajectories. Residual refinement brings the final policy to 90.8 PDMS in one step, within 0.1 points of ten steps at 3.29 × 3.29\times the inference speed, including image encoding.
blocks.zh: 收益从重建延伸到规划。 在NAVSIM上,\texorpdfstring\pdfxform @VITAL强化了视觉构造. 通过平等行动培训预算,它比仅接受轨迹培训的自动编码器在一步内获得了5.1 PDMS分. 剩余精细化使最终政策一步步达到90.8 PDMS,以3.29×3.29\乘以推断速度的10个步骤的0.1分,包括图像编码.

blocks.en: Our contributions bridge visual motion, precise action learning, and efficient policy refinement. • We propose \texorpdfstring \pdfxform @ VITAL, an action tokenizer that pairs visual motion with a normalized metric residual to preserve both visual grounding and fine trajectory precision for autonomous driving. • We propose residual reinforcement learning that improves planning through a single correction, without additional denoising, candidate search, or reward evaluation at inference. • We achieve 90.8 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 with a single flow evaluation. Without retraining, the same policy reaches 91.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and 38.6 EPDMS on reactive navhard .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献将视觉运动、精确的行动学习以及有效的政策完善相接。 我们提议 \texorpdfstring\pdfxform @ VITAL,一种将视觉运动与正常的公制余量配对的动作示意剂,以保持视觉地平面和精细的轨道精度,用于自主驾驶。 我们提议进行剩余的强化学习,通过一次更正改进规划工作,不进行额外的授意、寻找候选人或推论奖励评价。 我们在NAVSIM v1上实现90.8PDMS,单流评价. 在不进行再培训的情况下,NAVSIM v2的EPDMS达到了91.1,被动导航的EPDMS达到了38.6。

World-action models connect visual prediction to control by using generated futures or their latent representations to inform action generation.
Drive-WM evaluates candidate plans through generated multiview videos ( wang2024driving ) , while MaskGWM combines video generation with masked reconstruction to learn generalizable driving dynamics ( ni2025maskgwm ) .
DriveLaW injects video-generator latents into a trajectory planner ( xia2026drivelaw ) , and SUV lets the action expert attend to predicted appearance, semantics, relative depth, and instance dynamics ( yuan2026suv ) .
Metis and SimWAM use attention masks to support joint video-action training while avoiding future-video generation during action inference ( li2026metis ; zhao2026simwam ) .

blocks.en:
Broader surveys place both directions within agentic world modeling and vision-language-action driving systems ( chu2026agentic ; hu2025vlasurvey ) .
LCVN studies language-conditioned navigation through latent imagination or joint observation-action prediction, while UniWM couples future prediction with memory-augmented planning ( dong2026lcvn ; dong2026uniwm ) .
OneVL uses language and future-video supervision to learn compact reasoning tokens, discarding auxiliary decoders during planning inference ( lu2026onevl ) .
Beyond video, DynamicCity generates dynamic occupancy, while LiDARCrafter and U4D model controllable or uncertainty-aware LiDAR sequences ( bian2025dynamiccity ; liang2026lidarcrafter ; xu2026u4d ) . OmniLiDAR extends diffusion-based scan generation across weather, sensor configurations, and acquisition platforms through a shared range-image representation and domain-conditioned modeling ( liu2026omnilidar ) . These scene-generation interfaces provide a broader context for our focus on visually grounded, metric action targets.

blocks.en: Related strategies appear in robotic manipulation. Prediction with Action couples visual and action prediction through joint denoising ( guo2024prediction ) , and UWM uses independent video and action diffusion timesteps within one transformer to support policy and dynamics modeling ( zhu2025uwm ) . WorldVLA studies autoregressive action-world modeling ( cen2025worldvla ) ; VideoVLA and DreamZero leverage pretrained video generators to jointly predict actions and visual outcomes ( shen2025videovla ; ye2026dreamzero ) . Video Prediction Policy uses predictive visual representations with inverse dynamics ( hu2024video ) , while DreamVLA forecasts compact dynamic, spatial, and semantic knowledge for action prediction ( zhang2025dreamvla ) . V-JEPA 2-AC plans through an action-conditioned predictor in visual feature space ( assran2025vjepa2 ) . Gen2Act transfers information from generated human videos to manipulation ( bharadhwaj2024gen2act ) , and World Guidance predicts compact conditions derived from future observations alongside actions ( su2026world ) .

blocks.en: REPA aligns diffusion-model features with pretrained visual representations ( yu2024representation ) . For driving, Drive-JEPA learns predictive video representations for planning ( wang2026drive ) , ReWorld supervises intermediate video and action representations through prediction, alignment, and geometric discrimination ( xia2026reworld ) , and RAP introduces 3D geometric supervision through rasterization ( feng2026rap ) . Cross-modal alignment also supports 3D perception: CLIP2Scene and Seal transfer pretrained visual semantics to point clouds ( chen2023clip2scene ; liu2023seal ) , while LargeAD scales cross-sensor pretraining and LaserMix++ exploits multimodal consistency under limited annotation ( kong2026largead ; kong2025multimodal ) . PointLoRA adapts point-cloud representations with low-rank updates and token selection ( wang2025pointlora ) ; Pi3DET and 3EED examine cross-platform detection and language-grounded 3D localization ( liang2025pi3det ; li2025threeeed ) .

blocks.en:
Representation design also shapes the fidelity of driving perception. RangeFormer addresses projection-induced semantic and geometric distortions in range-view LiDAR segmentation ( kong2023rangeformer ) , while LaserMix uses spatially structured beam mixing and prediction consistency to learn from sparsely labeled scans ( kong2023lasermix ) . RoboBEV evaluates BEV perception under camera corruptions, sensor failures, and domain shifts ( xie2025robobev ) . These works concern perception accuracy, label efficiency, and robustness; our complementary question is how an action representation preserves metric detail
and remains predictable from visual conditioning.

RepWAM ( wang2026repwam ) and LingBot-VA 2.0 ( zhang2026native ) learn latent actions as transitions between semantically aligned visual states, with transport and residual components for reconstructing visual changes.

blocks.en: 2.5 Residual policy refinement

blocks.en:

DPPO optimizes diffusion policies through reinforcement learning ( ren2025diffusion ) , and ReinFlow adapts flow-matching policies with online RL ( zhang2025reinflow ) .
Flow Q-Learning combines flow-based behavior modeling with an expressive one-step policy optimized for value ( park2025fql ) .

blocks.en:
Residual RL learns corrections around an existing controller ( johannink2019residual ) , while Policy Decorator and ResiP refine imitation policies through residual control ( yuan2025policy ; ankile2025resip ) .
DSRL keeps the diffusion policy fixed and learns to steer its latent-noise inputs ( wagenmaker2025dsrl ) . \texorpdfstring \pdfxform @ VITAL also freezes the base action generator and decoder, but restricts intervention to the metric residual coordinates already defined by its tokenizer.
A fixed, bounded correction space preserves the predicted visual scaffold and provides a shared physical decoding map for imitation learning and policy improvement.
At deployment, the actor applies one deterministic correction, with no extra denoising or reward-based search.
This construction bounds the scope of local refinement; it does not guarantee that every correction improves reward or satisfies task-level safety.

blocks.en: 3.2 Visual Motion and Metric Residual Tokenization
blocks.zh: 3.2 视觉运动和残留计量

blocks.en: The representation assigns different roles to visual motion and execution detail. A visual scaffold can recover the overall path while retaining a small local displacement from the demonstrated trajectory. We encode that displacement relative to the recovered scaffold, giving the planner an explicit prediction target for the metric trajectory errors that remain after visual reconstruction.

Residual control and latent-noise steering provide related ways to improve imitation policies ( ankile2025resip ; wagenmaker2025dsrl ) ; here the intervention is confined to the paired metric residual. After imitation learning, we freeze the action generator, its visual conditioning, and the complete codec. A residual actor reads the frozen policy’s hidden states, current context, and base prediction, then outputs correction coordinates q ϕ ∈ ℝ k q_{\phi}\in\mathbb{R}^{k} . Reward optimization uses these coordinates to refine execution around the predicted scaffold.

Regularized whitening of the decoded Gram matrix balances the physical scales of these directions, giving a fixed matrix B ∈ ℝ d r × k B\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{r}\times k} . Their projection and whitening are computed from the frozen decoder geometry, then calibrated using training observations. The limiter enforces maximum positional and heading displacements of 1 m and 0.2 rad, respectively, together with a bound on residual-token magnitude. blocks.en: At deployment, the actor applies its deterministic mean correction once, using the same basis and normalization as during training. It requires no reward evaluation, candidate selection, or additional denoising. The complete policy therefore combines one action-expert evaluation with one bounded correction in the existing metric residual coordinates of the learned action representation.
blocks.zh: 在部署时,该行为体使用与培训时相同的依据和正常化,一次适用其确定性平均更正。 它不需要奖赏评价、候选人的甄选或额外的虚名。 因此,完整的政策将一项行动专家评价与现有已学到的行动说明的剩余坐标的有限度更正结合起来。

blocks.en:
Datasets and benchmarks. NAVSIM evaluates driving trajectories in simulation ( dauner2024navsim ; cao2025pseudo ) .
We report PDMS on v1 navtest , corrected EPDMS on v2 navtest , and reactive two-stage EPDMS on navhard . These scores summarize collision avoidance, road compliance, progress, and comfort on a scale from 0 to 100. We also report average and final displacement errors, ADE and FDE, in meters. All three evaluations use the policy trained on v1. The diagnostic experiments use deterministic, matched evaluation panels: reconstruction uses all 18,179 validation scenes, action learning uses a log-balanced panel of 4,096 scenes, and frozen-feature probes use a nested 512-scene panel. All fitted codecs and normalization statistics use training data only. Reconstruction and probe errors use the dense 10 Hz grid; the action-learning comparison evaluates displacement at the eight nominal planning times, so errors on these different grids are interpreted within their respective protocols.

blocks.en: Training and inference. We train the main model on one server with eight NVIDIA H200 GPUs. At inference, \texorpdfstring \pdfxform @ VITAL predicts one four-second trajectory from the current front image, ego state, and navigation command. NFE counts action expert evaluations. Latency includes image encoding and residual correction at batch size one on an RTX 4090. See Appendices and for full protocols. Timing includes preprocessing, host-to-device transfer, visual conditioning, action integration, and trajectory construction, with scene-file I/O and initial weight loading excluded. We synchronize the GPU around the complete call and measure the held-out timing panel after warmup. Across the sampling sweep, the policy, inference seed, decoder, and residual actor remain fixed, isolating the cost and benefit of additional action-flow evaluations.
